stanza: I asked the room if I'd said enough
No one really answered
They just said "Don't go, don't go
Don't go, don't go, don't go"
All this leaving is never ending
I kept hoping for one more question
Or for someone to say
"Who do you think you are?"
So I could tell them

answered.line: Yelled down the hall, but nobody answered
stanza: No longer a danger to herself or others
She made up her mind and laced up her shoes
Yelled down the hall, but nobody answered
So she walked outside without an excuse
